newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica's maximum retail price set at 3,385 pta.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica's maximum retail price set at 3,385 pta.

text.p: Spain's state holding company SEPPa set the maximum retail price for the sale of its shares in Telefonica de Espana at 3,385 pesetas per share, the telecoms company said in a statement.
SEPPa also increased the amount of shares being offered to the general public in Spain to bring the retail tranche to 102,646,079 shares, or 60 percent of the initial offer.
The maximum price is based on the average weighted price of Telefonica shares on Spain's cash market during the five sessions that ended on February 7.
The retail portion may be increased further by SEPPa at the request of all the global coordinators before January 17.
